text.p: Caldera Technologies Corp said on Friday that chairman Rick Landry and president and chief executive officer Conrad Taylor have resigned.
Also, Gerald Hansberger, the company's chief financial officer, resigned, but will continue as a consultant, Caldera said.
Caldera, a maker of water filtration products, has decided to consolidated the majority of its operations in Covington, Louisiana, and will close its Rosemont, Illinois, office, the company said.
Landry and Taylor's roles will be transfered to the operations at the Sterling Air and Water unit in Louisiana or the company's board, Hansberger said in a telephone interview.
The company is 89 percent owned by Trilon Dominion LLC, Caldera said.
The idea behind the move is to reduce the company's corporate infrastructure costs to focus on operations, Hansberger said.
